::: {.callout-note}
## Conflicting or unsettled dates
The commissioning brief asks this archive to accommodate CSIL design or authorization around **1993**, a pilot around **1994**, and later disagreement about which year counts as a start. This page does not choose between 1993 and 1994.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can separate, with citations:

- program design and ministry authorization
- a pilot
- province-wide availability
- later retrospective start dates

Those may be different events. They should not be merged in prose until sources are inspected.

## Evidence status

- **Documented facts:** none recorded on this page yet.
- **Bibliographically confirmed (copy sought):** [original Ministry of Health CSIL pilot/design records](../sources/wanted-ministry-csil-pilot-records.qmd), approximately 1993–95, described as likely involving the Continuing Care Division / Community Support Branch.
- **Conflicting evidence to preserve:** 1993 versus 1994 as a CSIL starting year in later accounts.
- **Open questions:** what “start” refers to in each later account; which records survive; what the pilot’s scope was.
